changes.title: WorkspaceBrowser virtualized session list + memoized rows (product overlay)
changes.upstreamDependency: Upstream WorkspaceBrowser renders every session row (each carrying a portal Menu, HoverCard and drag handlers) on every interaction; with 100+ sessions the sidebar re-renders and re-animates all of them and feels frozen. This rule overlays a fixed-height (32px) virtualized flat list with overscan and memoizes SessionNodeItem with mount animation disabled; upstream render semantics stay untouched.
changes.updateRule: Rows stay fixed at ROW_HEIGHT=32 with ROW_OVERSCAN=12; after editing, run product:frontend-sync then rebuild the desktop shell. Keep the two files in lockstep: memoized rows are what make virtualization cheap.
changes.verify: pnpm run product:guard && node product/tools/rebuild-frontend-overlay.mjs && pnpm run product:source-check

changes.title: dsh-peak-valley clock throttled from rAF to 1s (perf fix)
changes.upstreamDependency: Upstream has no peak-valley plugin; this is a product plugin. The footer/section clock used requestAnimationFrame to setState every frame (60fps), re-rendering both components and executing Intl.DateTimeFormat.formatToParts each time, keeping the renderer main thread saturated and freezing the whole client.
changes.updateRule: Keep the clock at 1s granularity (setTimeout 1000ms); the progress bar already has CSS transitions for smooth movement. If the bundle needs rebuilding, apply the same change to both lib/client.js and lib/client-bundle.js.
changes.verify: pnpm run product:guard && node product/tools/rebuild-frontend-overlay.mjs && pnpm run product:source-check

changes.title: ChatNodeSeat viewport-gated mounting (long conversation perf)
changes.upstreamDependency: Upstream ChatView maps every chat Node at once. Long sessions (largest is a 19MB compressed log, thousands of Nodes) mount all rows on open, blocking the renderer during session switches and Node jumps. Product gates each seat on IntersectionObserver proximity (1400px margin), mounts once and keeps mounted, and caches measured heights so the scroller stays stable.

changes.title: runtime-host verify 探针保留公告 URL 的 token（修复较新上游 401 导致打包自检失败）

changes.title: runtime-host verify 探针自行完成浏览器认证换票（修复打包自检 HTTP 401）
changes.notes: R47 保留 token 后仍 401。读上游新 tag 实现 packages/client/connection/src/browser-auth.ts 得知契约变了：带合法 ?token= 的 GET / 返回 **303 Location:/ + Set-Cookie dsh-auth-<authority-hash>**（HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict，签名 cookie），只有携带该 cookie 的请求才拿 index；无 token 或错 token 则 401。Node fetch 不持久化 cookie，故探针首跳必然跟到无 cookie 的 / → 401。修法：新增 probeWebHost() —— redirect:manual 取 303 的 Set-Cookie，用 Cookie 头复请 /，校验 200+text/html+__DSH_BOOT__；旧版 host 直出 HTML 的路径保留兼容；错 token 仍正确拒绝。

changes.title: 壳层适配 host 浏览器认证：公告 URL 保留 token + 就绪探测接受换票重定向 + 主进程请求带会话 cookie
changes.notes: 与 R47/R48 同源问题：上游 0.1.6-alpha.1 起 host 强制浏览器认证（合法 GET /?token= → 303 + Set-Cookie 签名 cookie，无 cookie 一律 401）。壳侧三处受影响：①waitForAnnouncedUrl 正则只截 origin，丢掉 ?token= → 窗口 loadURL 裸 origin 必 401 白屏（已改为保留完整 URL）；②probeHost 用普通 fetch（自动跟跳到无 cookie 的 /）→ 就绪探测永远失败（改为 redirect:manual，3xx+Location 即视为 host 已就绪，认证握手交由窗口完成）；③主进程无 cookie jar，warmUpModelDirectory 的 /api/* 请求会 401 导致模型目录预热静默失效（新增 authCookieFor(origin) 一次性换票并缓存，请求带 cookie 头）。旧版无认证 host 全部路径保持兼容。
